LLT / UNIT 5 / SECTION G1

Intelligent Storage Capacity

From “disk full” surprises to informed capacity decisions.

The use case

A shared engineering lab accumulates project archives, media and duplicate submissions. The administrator needs to understand consumption and estimate when additional capacity will be needed.

The solution

A read-only Python scanner inventories a chosen folder, groups equal-size files, verifies duplicate content using SHA-256, and exports JSON. This dashboard shows composition, a configurable growth forecast, and a cleanup preview.

What makes it intelligent?

Content-based duplicate detection and transparent decision rules. Runway = remaining capacity ÷ selected daily growth. This prototype uses no trained ML model. Forecasts are scenarios and do not infer future demand from a single scan.
